preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(A) == list(range(1, N+1)) and len(A) == N for A in [])
preconditions.description: For each test case, A is a permutation of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(P) == list(range(1, N+1)) and len(P) == N for P in [])
preconditions.description: For each test case, P is a permutation of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(Q, int) and Q >= 1 for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, Q is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for op in [] if op[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, x and y are valid distinct indices within [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for op in [] if op[0] == 3)
preconditions.description: For type 3 operations, x is a valid index within [1, N].
The sum of N and the sum of Q over all test cases do not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == len([op for op in all_ops if op[0] == 3])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the total number of type 3 operations across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == current_A[x-1] for line, (x, current_A) in zip(stdout_lines, query_states))
postconditions.description: Each output line corresponds to the value at position x in the current state of array A after applying all preceding operations for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and 1 <= int(line) <= N for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Every output value is an integer within the valid range [1, N].
